snippet.title: STARWAKE: Echoes of Time – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
STEAM: coming soon (end of Q4 2026 / Q1 2027), once Valve has approved our tax and identity checks.
No need to wait for Steam: STARWAKE launches 1 December on its own launcher, from our website: https://starwake.site
Pre-purchase is open now, 25% off on our website (it funds this dream and keeps it going): https://starwake.site/buy
Payments are handled by Polar; cards are processed by Stripe.

STARWAKE: Echoes of Time is a Single Player (Co-op coming shortly) HD pixel-art action roguelike for Windows PC. Fight in real time as one of four heroes, wield the powers of twenty gods, and when you fall, the night rewinds and you rise stronger.

✦ WHAT AWAITS YOU
▸ Four playable heroes, Orrin, Holm, Vela and Tally, each with two ascended forms
▸ 20 gods and 331 boon cards to shape every run
▸ A cinematic ultimate for every god, fought in real time
▸ Six worlds and a final dimension, each guarded by a boss
▸ Starfall Town, your living home between nights
▸ The Orrery of Hours, a skill tree that makes every night stronger
▸ Five Vaults hidden beneath the town
▸ Fully animated anime cinematics
▸ Play with keyboard or controller
▸ Steam release coming by end of 2026!
…and much more, with every update shaped by the community.

✦ PRE-PURCHASE NOW
$14.99 until launch on 1 December 2026, 18:00 UTC (then $19.99).
Full refund for any reason before launch.
👉 https://starwake.site/buy
Or wishlist it for free and get one e-mail on launch day: https://starwake.site/wishlist

✦ LINKS
🌐 Website: https://starwake.site
🛒 Pre-purchase: https://starwake.site/buy
📰 Press kit: https://starwake.site/press
🛟 Support: support@starwake.site
🤝 Collaborations & partnerships: hello@starwake.site

✦ ABOUT
A solo developer project, created by Raz Avnor.
Honest note: STARWAKE was made with generative AI tools under one director's direction, including much of the art, the anime scenes in this trailer, voices and part of the music. The gameplay in this trailer is captured from the game.

🎵 Music: 決断の瞬間 (The Moment of Decision)

#Starwake #ActionRoguelike #PixelArt #IndieGame #Roguelike
